# **How Swipe made our quotation and invoicing process hassle-free**


My name is Manish, and i am the co-founder of Elephant AI Agency, a creative advertising agency focused on design, data, and digital performance.


Like every other agency owner, our responsibilities span across client interactions, strategising, creating advertisements and even handling some paperwork. In recent times, i have noticed that generating invoices and quotations has been automated at many firms. This was not the case when we were working on automating things at Elephant AI Agency.


We used to do it manually — every single time.


Open wWord, format the doc, add the numbers, save it, and email it.


Sounds simple? Trust me, when you're juggling five campaigns at once, it’s a nightmare.


We knew we had to change something.


## **How we discovered Swipe**


In the course of our investigations, we found an application and browser-based platform Swipe, which seemed to be made for businesses like ours.


The promise was simple:


**Create professional invoices and quotations with just the basic info, in minutes — no design, no formatting, no stress.**


And it delivered exactly that.


## **What has changed for us**


With Swipe, we didn’t just find a tool — we found a *system* . A system that:


Generates clean, professional quotations instantly.


Works from any browser — no need to install anything.


Makes invoice creation feel like a two-minute task.


Keeps everything stored in one place — no more hunting down old Word files.


We just enter the client details and the basic info, and Swipe takes care of the rest. The output? Polished, client-ready documents that we’re proud to send.


## **Why i recommend Swipe to creative agencies**


Within the creative service industry, i can attest that your effort is better allocated to conceptual framework building rather than generating repetitive invoices. Swipe not only helped save us time and reduce redundancy, but also helped improve our image in front of clients.


## **Final thoughts**


For us at Elephant AI Agency, Swipe transitioned from a novel tool to a critical element of our processes. If you are still trapped in the painstaking task of configuring Word documents for your quotes and invoices, take my word for it; there is an easier alternative out there.


[Try Swipe](https://getswipe.in/) **. Simplify your process. And get back to doing the work you love.**
